Name: Azaziah, Singer
Summary: Levite appointed to sing with harps on the Sheminith at the bringing up of the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:21: Levite appointed to sing with harps on the Sheminith at the bringing up of the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azaziah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
